title: Ozark Christmas Parade Gathering at The Workshop
seo_title: Ozark Christmas Parade Gathering at The Workshop
description: The Workshop is open late before and during the Ozark Christmas Parade, with hot chocolate, live fire-baked pizza, and campfires. You can watch the parade from the patio or find a spot along the route as it passes Finley Farms, and no registration is required. It runs Saturday, November 21, 2026, from 3:00 PM to 7:30 PM at 840 Finley Farms Ln in Ozark, Missouri.
